description: Angular component for managing mobile page items in a UI, including editing, validation, and popover interactions.

classes.name: MobilePageItemRowComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and managing individual mobile page items, supporting default and custom pages, validation, and popover editing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets icon width, subscribes to hideItems observable.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form with given page data, sets flags for default or custom page.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Resets visibility, icon, and label for default pages, updates model.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens popover for editing page details, handles default and custom page editing.

methods.name: updateIconNameBlockWidth
methods.description: Sets icon name block width based on max width.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model based on form values, propagates change.

methods.name: updateCleanupState
methods.description: Determines if cleanup is enabled based on page state.

methods.name: updateItemInfo
methods.description: Updates item info text based on page type.

methods.name: afterPageEdit
methods.description: Updates form and model after editing a page.
